1. Two of the appellants namely, Jai Pal Singh Dabas and Satpal Singh are reported to have expired and by way of the aforementioned applications, their LRs are sought to be substituted in their place.

2. As per the applications, appellant Jai Pal Singh Dabas is survived by his son Devesh Dabas and daughter Divya while appellant Satpal Singh is survived by Usha (wife), Rahul Dabas (son) and Anuradha (daughter).
3.
Issue notice.
4. Standing Counsel for the UOI /R-1 and Ms. Mrinalini Sen Gupta, This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/12/2023 at 23:43:41 Standing Counsel for DDA/R-2 accept notice who may file reply within 4 weeks from today.
5. List for completion of pleadings qua both these applications before the Registrar on 13th February. 2024.

1. This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 30.05.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge, North -01, Rohini Courts, New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 90/2018 seeking further enhancement of compensation amount in respect of award No. 12/2005-06/DC/(NW) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Barwala,

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The following relief has been sought by the appellant:

"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed to YOUR LORDSHPS that the appeal may kindly be accepted and the market value of the land of the appellant be further enhanced by Rs. 50,000/ per bigha besides other statutory benefits as admissible under Land Acquisition Act, 1894, as amended up to date, be passed in favour of the Appellant and against the respondents and the appellant be further granted additional amount as provided under section 23 (1A) and Solatium as provided under section 23(2) and interest on the said sums as per the judgment of Sunder's case be modifying the order judgment & decree dated 30-05-2023 passed by the Learned lower court of Sh.
